The '''''Mera'din''''' is a recent formation of a "society" among the [[Aiel]]. The name means "Brotherless" in the [[Old Tongue]].

==History==
When the ''[[Car'a'carn]]'', [[Rand al'Thor]], spread the news about the [[Aiel#Origins|true origins of the Aiel]], many were unwilling to follow someone who spread such news about them, regardless of the truth of it. Some of these, all men, joined the [[Shaido]] clan who were already in rebellion against him; they were scorned for abandoning their clans and septs, and began to be referred to as the "Brotherless."{{ref/book|5|2}} After a time with the Shaido, many of the ''Mera'din'' plan to return to the [[Aiel Waste|Three-fold Land]].{{ref/book|11|5}}
